name: Shadow Hands
body:
School illumination (evocation) [cold]; Level alchemist 1, shadowsworn 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.
Area semicircular wave of shadow 10 ft. in radius, centered on your hands
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A freezing blast of shadow leaps from your hands in a fan pattern. Any creature caught in the shadows takes 1d6 hp cold damage per caster level (maximum 5d6).

Mythic: A creature caught in the shadow takes 1d8 hp cold damage per caster level and if it fails its saving throw it is frightened. The spell gains the fear descriptor.
